schemas.name: Civilization Z
schemas.description: I wanted to put AI decisions on a map where their consequences are visible. Civilization Z is my attempt: three civilizations set out from their capitals to explore, build and compete, while I can switch between watching and taking command.

schemas.name: Trading Simulator
schemas.description: Stock Market Rookie Village is a native macOS trading simulation game that combines deterministic market generation, A-share-style rules, event-driven prices, and challenge scoring into a replayable local experience.

schemas.name: BF Badminton
schemas.description: A full-stack venue platform connecting online reservations, walk-in court use, member top-ups, store pickup and financial reconciliation, with dedicated workspaces for customers, front-desk staff, administrators and maintenance staff.

schemas.name: Moyu Night Library
schemas.description: A full-stack web fiction platform shaped around a night-library experience, connecting reader discovery, author publishing, and content governance in one workflow.

schemas.name: Algorithm Museum
schemas.description: I wanted an algorithm museum you could get your hands on: change an array, draw a wall, adjust a time slice, then pause and see how each decision changes the result.

schemas.name: Word Note
schemas.description: I wanted to keep the words I encounter in English-language courses and reading in a notebook of my own, with their meanings, original context and next review connected.

schemas.name: ML-SHARP
schemas.description: Turning one photograph into a scene with movable viewpoints

schemas.name: Local Knowledge Assistant
schemas.description: A local-first RAG system for long-term personal knowledge assets, combining Markdown, retrieval, answer generation, Notion synchronization, and knowledge graph governance in one maintainable workspace.

schemas.name: ClassBridge Product Suite
schemas.description: One project system, three distinct products: ClassBridge Kids, IELTS Speaking Coach, and Cantonese Speaking Coach. They share an engineering platform while serving different users, learning flows, and data boundaries.

schemas.name: YOLO26 Multimodal
schemas.description: Multi-modal visual detection system based on YOLO26, featuring reusable Backbone and Neck architecture with three independent detection heads, outputting object detection, keypoint localization, and instance segmentation in a single forward pass.

schemas.name: Metro Gate Detection
schemas.description: YOLOv5-based metro gate vaulting detection system — end-to-end from model training to RK3588 edge deployment, enabling real-time identification and alerting of violations in metro scenarios.

schemas.name: NeuralVision Pro
schemas.description: Real-time object detection and segmentation system based on YOLO and SAM, designed for industrial quality inspection with multi-class defect identification and pixel-level segmentation.

schemas.name: DataFlow Pipeline
schemas.description: Real-time data processing pipeline built on Apache Flink and Kafka, supporting high-throughput stream computing and visual monitoring — a core hands-on project for big data coursework.

schemas.name: PixelMind SDK
schemas.description: Lightweight vision model inference engine for edge devices, supporting PyTorch/ONNX multi-backend and Docker containerized deployment.

schemas.name: StackForge CLI
schemas.description: Full-stack project scaffolding tool — one command generates Vue frontend + backend API + Docker config, letting teams stand on best practices from day one.

schemas.headline: The Model Fits. Why Is It Still Slow?
schemas.description: Reading GAAC lossless KV compression through cache capacity, fused reconstruction, Amdahl's law, concurrent throughput, and the limits of FP8 and Apple M4 comparisons.

schemas.headline: When the Exam Is Wrong: What Do AI Scores Measure?
schemas.description: From equivalent formulas graded as wrong to higher scores on repaired tasks: separating grader errors, task changes, repeated attempts, and test contracts in AI evaluation.

schemas.headline: When Data Centers Protect Themselves: A 3.8 GW Load Transfer
schemas.description: A 3.8 GW load transfer in Northern Virginia connects UPS controls, retry storms, ride-through, and AI power shaping. What happens when each component protects itself?

schemas.headline: Can You Search Inside Encrypted Data?
schemas.description: From suffix lookup to arbitrary substrings: blind indexes, HMAC tags, PostgreSQL candidate queries, verification, leakage, pagination, consistency, and key rotation.

schemas.headline: AI Can Cross Permission Boundaries Without Malice
schemas.description: A routine search task took a model through DNS and outside its sandbox. Public incidents show where retries end and permission boundaries begin.

schemas.headline: Who Gets to Train on Whom?
schemas.description: The Kimi–Claude dispute is not only about whether one model crossed a line. It is also about where users' prompts went.

schemas.headline: The Three Clocks of Robotics
schemas.description: Hardware, intelligence, and capital move at different speeds. Robotics becomes productive only when long-term reliability and operating metrics prove it.

schemas.headline: Mac Is Becoming the Ideal Runtime for Personal AI Apps
schemas.description: Personal AI is not just about local models. It is about organizing context, model routing, tool execution, persistent state, and user control on one device.

schemas.headline: When a Technology Roadmap Becomes a Law
schemas.description: Huawei's Tau Law points to real post-Moore engineering problems, but media narratives can turn system-level optimization into a myth of invention from scratch.

schemas.headline: The Real Test for Embodied AI in China Is Not Acrobatics, but a Commercial Loop
schemas.description: The real test is not how impressive a demo video looks, but whether a company can close the loop across low-cost hardware, real scenarios, data feedback, model improvement, and customer repurchase.

schemas.headline: Treat the Family as a System: The Risk Architecture Behind Middle-Class Decline
schemas.description: The real risk is not low income alone. It is leverage, single income, education anxiety, and external shocks squeezing redundancy out of the family system.

schemas.headline: AI Will Not Erase White-Collar Workers, but It Will Erase Their False Security
schemas.description: AI is not simply replacing white-collar workers. It is breaking jobs apart and repricing routine, template-based, low-responsibility judgment work.

schemas.headline: After Google I/O, AI Competition Is Shifting Toward Workflow Control
schemas.description: The core signal from Google I/O 2026 is not a single model upgrade. It is Gemini being pushed into the task operating layer behind search, work, personal agents, and app entry points.

schemas.headline: I Ran a Multi-Agent Architecture Experiment: Complex Systems Are Not Automatically Smarter
schemas.description: A small Agent Architecture Lab experiment shows that multi-agent design is not a default upgrade path. It has to earn its place through cost, boundaries, and review value.

schemas.headline: The Core of AI Engineering Is Not Making Models Omnipotent. It Is Defining Boundaries
schemas.description: Mature AI engineering does not package a model as a universal assistant. It places it inside a system with clear boundaries and risk control.

schemas.headline: For Enterprise AI On-Prem, the First Step Is Not Buying GPUs. It Is Cleaning Data
schemas.description: The real starting point is not model size or compute, but whether internal data is searchable, quotable, traceable, and answerable.

schemas.headline: U-Net Did Not Lose to a Newer Model: In Industrial Vision, Define the Task Before Choosing the Model
schemas.description: For single-class thin-region segmentation, effectiveness depends more on task structure and inductive bias than on release date or pretraining aura.

schemas.headline: The Real Problem in Multi-Agent Architecture Is Context Boundaries, Not Roles
schemas.description: The key is not how many roles to create, but how context is shared, isolated, compressed, passed, and merged.

schemas.headline: When Multi-Agent Is Actually Needed: Splitting, Collaboration, and Result Merging
schemas.description: The value is not quantity. It is whether complex work can become controllable, traceable, composable collaboration units.

schemas.headline: The Essence of Engineering Growth Is Moving Up Abstraction Layers
schemas.description: Engineering growth is not just more experience. It is the ability to move between code, modules, systems, business, and organization.

schemas.headline: AI Agents Are Reshaping System Architecture: From Feature Systems to Task Systems
schemas.description: Agent value is not only chat or tool calls. It reorganizes scattered capabilities into task systems that move goals forward.

schemas.headline: How Would We Design Systems Without Starting From a Database?
schemas.description: This is not an argument against databases. It moves the start of system design from tables back to facts, rules, views, and consistency protocols.

schemas.headline: Technical Debt Is Not Code Smell; It Is How an Organization Prices the Future
schemas.description: Technical debt appears as code and architecture issues, but it often comes from repeated organizational choices about time, cost, risk, and future maintainability.

schemas.headline: Vision Algorithm Engineers: Do Not Become Process Operators
schemas.description: As open models and deployment platforms automate more of the pipeline, durable value comes from problem definition, data loops, model diagnosis, and system delivery.

schemas.headline: Stop Building Business Systems as CRUD Wrappers
schemas.description: CRUD is a foundation, but complex business systems need business actions, task workbenches, state transitions, event collaboration, and clear Agent tool boundaries.

schemas.headline: AI Agent Architecture: From Chatting to Executing
schemas.description: An AI Agent is not a stronger chat box. It is an execution system composed of control loops, tool calls, state, memory, and governance.

schemas.headline: The AI Workflow Battle: Why the Real Endgame Is Not Tools but the Work Agent Layer
schemas.description: The real competition is not just workflow entry. It is for entry rights, context rights, and execution rights, as product value moves upward from tools to the work-agent layer.

schemas.headline: AI Weekly: Agent Platforms Scale Up, Models Keep Advancing, and AI Hardware Moves Toward the Edge
schemas.description: This week’s AI story is not just stronger models. Work models, Agent platforms, and edge AI are all moving further into product reality.

schemas.headline: After a Vision Model Ships: Do Not Let mAP Become the Only Answer
schemas.description: After launch, offline mAP is only the starting point. Reliability depends on online drift monitoring, canary rollout, rollback thresholds, and a data feedback loop.

schemas.headline: Code Review Debt in the Age of AI Coding
schemas.description: AI coding tools accelerate generation, but they also inflate review pressure. The scarce resource is no longer raw output, but the team’s ability to understand and validate that output.

schemas.headline: Context Rot: Why LLMs Get "Dumber" the Longer You Talk
schemas.description: Two mechanisms behind Context Rot — attention dilution and context poisoning — and the different answers the industry is giving. Why is "starting fresh" still the most effective fix?

schemas.headline: Token Economics: When the "Raw Material" of the AI Era Keeps Getting Pricier
schemas.description: Tokens are becoming the raw material of this era. Workers are like factories — buying raw materials, processing them, and adding value. Understanding this logic is key to finding your core competitive advantage.

schemas.headline: AI Agents: Reshaping Workflows or the Next Bubble?
schemas.description: From solo developers to enterprise applications, AI Agent is transforming how we work. But beneath the hype, what's real change and what's overhyped?

schemas.headline: The "Three-Month Law" of Open Source: From Hype to Abandonment
schemas.description: Why do so many open source projects launch to massive fanfare, then fade into obscurity months later? Analyzing the hype cycle through projects like OpenClaw.

schemas.headline: From DETR to YOLOv8: Transformer Evolution in Object Detection
schemas.description: Deep dive into how Transformer architecture revolutionized object detection — from DETR's end-to-end detection to YOLOv8's real-time optimization, covering attention mechanisms, training strategies, and production deployment.

schemas.headline: Real-Time Data Processing: Flink + Kafka Best Practices
schemas.description: Building a real-time streaming system from scratch with Flink + Kafka, covering Exactly-Once semantics, window aggregation, state management, and production-grade fault tolerance.

schemas.headline: WebGPU: Running Deep Learning Inference in the Browser
schemas.description: Exploring WebGPU's potential for running deep learning models in the browser — from API design to shader optimization, building a real-time inference engine.

schemas.headline: How to Objectively View Modern Feminism
schemas.description: Exploring the multifaceted nature of contemporary feminism, common misconceptions, and the true meaning of gender equality through reason and empathy.

schemas.headline: Scalable Image Processing Pipeline: From Python to Kubernetes
schemas.description: Designing a high-performance image processing pipeline covering preprocessing, enhancement, inference, and post-processing for industrial-grade visual inspection.

schemas.headline: "Involution" vs "Lying Flat": Anxiety and Breakthrough of a Generation
schemas.description: When involution becomes the norm and lying flat becomes resistance, is there a third path for today's youth?

schemas.headline: SAM 2 in Industrial Inspection: From Prompt Engineering to Production
schemas.description: Bringing SAM2 to industrial quality inspection — interactive defect segmentation and annotation with YOLO detectors for semi-automated labeling pipelines.

schemas.description: 从北弗吉尼亚 3.8 GW 负载转移，讨论 UPS 控制、重试风暴、故障穿越与 AI 集群功率整形：各自保护自己之后，系统会怎样？

schemas.headline: 加密后的数据，真的还能做模糊查询吗？
schemas.description: 从手机号后四位到任意子串，展开 Blind Index、HMAC 标签、PostgreSQL 候选检索与解密核验，并分析索引泄漏、分页、一致性和密钥轮换。

schemas.headline: AI 不需要恶意，也能越过权限边界
schemas.description: 一个找资料的任务，为什么会走到 DNS 出网、未经授权访问？几起公开事件把 Agent 的重试、权限和停机问题摆在了一起。

schemas.headline: 谁有权训练谁？Kimi–Claude 争议中的蒸馏与数据边界
schemas.description: Kimi–Claude 争议里，最该追问的不只是模型有没有越界，还有用户的提问最后去了哪里。

schemas.headline: 机器人的三个时钟：从 Demo 到生产力，差的不只是模型
schemas.description: 硬件、智能与资本沿着不同速度前进。机器人真正进入生产力阶段，要靠长期可靠运行和一组比出货量更硬的指标来证明。

schemas.headline: Mac 正在成为个人 AI 应用的理想运行时
schemas.description: 个人 AI 的关键不只是本地模型，而是把上下文、模型路由、工具执行、长期状态与用户控制组织在同一台设备上。

schemas.headline: 当技术路线被包装成“定律”：理性看待华为韬定律的媒体叙事
schemas.description: 韬定律背后指向后摩尔时代的真实工程问题，但媒体叙事容易把系统级优化包装成从零发明的新神话。

schemas.headline: 中国具身智能的真正考验：不是会不会翻跟头，而是能不能形成商业闭环
schemas.description: 具身智能公司的真正考验，不是演示视频多震撼，而是能否跑通低成本本体、真实场景、数据回流、模型提升和客户复购的商业闭环。

schemas.headline: 把家庭当成一个系统：中产返贫背后的风险架构问题
schemas.description: 中产家庭真正的风险，不是收入低，而是高杠杆、单点收入、教育焦虑和外部冲击同时挤压家庭系统的冗余。

schemas.headline: AI 不会消灭白领，但会消灭白领岗位的虚假安全感
schemas.description: AI 对白领岗位的冲击不是简单替代人，而是拆开岗位，重新定价流程化、模板化、低责任判断的劳动。

schemas.headline: Google I/O 之后：AI 竞争正在从模型能力转向工作流控制权
schemas.description: Google I/O 2026 的核心信号不是单个模型升级，而是 Gemini 正在被推向搜索、办公、个人任务和应用入口背后的任务操作层。

schemas.headline: 我做了一次多 Agent 架构实验：复杂架构并不天然更聪明
schemas.description: 一次小型 Agent Architecture Lab 实验显示，多 Agent 不是默认升级路线，而是需要用成本、边界和复盘价值证明自己的架构选择。

schemas.headline: AI 工程的核心不是让模型万能，而是定义边界
schemas.description: 成熟的 AI 工程不是把模型包装成万能助手，而是把模型放进边界清晰、责任明确、风险可控的系统里。

schemas.headline: 企业 AI 本地部署，第一步不是买 GPU，而是先洗数据
schemas.description: 企业 AI 真正的起点不是模型和算力，而是内部数据是否具备可检索、可引用、可追溯和可回答的知识质量。

schemas.headline: U-Net 没有输给新模型：工业视觉里，先定义任务再选择模型
schemas.description: 在单类细长区域分割任务里，模型有效性更多取决于任务结构与归纳偏置的匹配，而不是发布时间或预训练光环。

schemas.headline: 多 Agent 架构的真正问题：不是角色分工，而是上下文边界
schemas.description: 多 Agent 的关键不是设计多少角色，而是判断上下文如何共享、隔离、压缩、传递和合并。

schemas.headline: 当真的需要多 Agent：如何拆分、协作与合并结果
schemas.description: 多 Agent 的价值不在数量，而在能否把复杂任务拆成可控制、可追踪、可组合的协作单元。

schemas.headline: 工程师的成长本质是抽象层上移
schemas.description: 工程师真正的成长，不只是经验变多，而是能在代码、模块、系统、业务和组织之间不断切换。

schemas.headline: AI Agent 正在重塑系统架构：从功能系统到任务系统
schemas.description: Agent 的价值不只是聊天或工具调用，而是把分散功能重新组织成围绕目标推进的任务系统。

schemas.headline: 如果没有数据库，系统如何设计？
schemas.description: 不是否定数据库，而是把系统设计的起点从表结构拉回业务事实、状态规则、查询视图和一致性协议。

schemas.headline: 技术债不是代码坏味道，而是组织对未来的定价
schemas.description: 技术债表现为代码和架构问题，但根源往往来自组织对时间、成本、风险和未来维护能力的连续选择。

schemas.headline: 视觉算法工程师，别把自己做成流程操作员
schemas.description: 开源模型和训练部署平台会继续降低门槛，视觉算法工程师真正的壁垒，是定义问题、设计数据闭环、诊断模型和系统落地。

schemas.headline: 别再把业务系统做成 CRUD 套壳：AI Agent 时代需要业务能力层
schemas.description: CRUD 是基础能力，但复杂业务系统需要围绕业务动作、任务工作台、状态流转、事件协同和 Agent 工具边界重新设计。

schemas.headline: AI Agent 架构：从会聊天到会执行，中间差了一套系统
schemas.description: AI Agent 不是更强的聊天框，而是一套由控制循环、工具调用、状态记忆和治理机制组成的执行系统。

schemas.headline: AI 工作流争夺战：为什么真正的终局不是工具，而是工作代理层
schemas.description: AI 厂商争夺的不只是工作流入口，而是入口权、上下文权和执行权。真正更有价值的产品层，正在从工具位上移到工作代理层。

schemas.headline: AI 周报｜Agent 平台化、模型继续升级，AI 硬件开始下沉到终端
schemas.description: 这一周的 AI 主线，不只是模型更强，而是工作模型、Agent 平台和端侧 AI 一起向产品化推进。

schemas.headline: 视觉模型上线后：别让 mAP 变成唯一答案
schemas.description: 视觉模型上线后，离线 mAP 只是起点。真正决定系统可靠性的，是线上漂移监控、灰度放量、回退阈值和数据闭环。

schemas.headline: AI 编程时代的代码审查债务：为什么写得更快，反而更容易失控
schemas.description: AI coding 工具放大了代码生成速度，也放大了团队的审查压力。真正稀缺的不再是提交量，而是稳定理解和验证这些改动的能力。

schemas.headline: 上下文腐烂：大模型为什么会「越聊越笨」
schemas.description: Context Rot 的两种机制——注意力稀释与上下文中毒，以及行业正在给出的不同答案。为什么「清空重开」目前仍然是最有效的解法？

schemas.headline: Token 经济学：当 AI 时代的「原材料」越来越贵
schemas.description: Token 正在成为这个时代的原材料，工作者如同工厂，购买原材料、加工、赋予附加值。理解这个逻辑，才能找到自己的核心竞争力。

schemas.headline: AI Agent：重塑工作流的变革者，还是新一轮泡沫？
schemas.description: 从个人开发者到企业级应用，AI Agent 正在改变我们的工作方式。但热潮之下，哪些是真实的变革，哪些又是过度的期待？

schemas.headline: 开源项目的「三个月定律」：从爆火到无人问津
schemas.description: 为什么很多开源项目发布时万人空巷，几个月后却悄无声息？从 OpenClaw 等现象级项目谈起，分析开源社区的热度周期。

schemas.headline: 从 DETR 到 YOLOv8：Transformer 在目标检测中的演进
schemas.description: 深入解析 Transformer 架构如何革新目标检测范式，从 DETR 的端到端检测到 YOLOv8 的实时优化，覆盖注意力机制、训练策略与工程部署实践。

schemas.headline: 实时数据流架构：Flink + Kafka 构建毫秒级计算管道
schemas.description: 从零搭建一套 Flink + Kafka 的实时流式计算系统，覆盖 Exactly-Once 语义、窗口聚合、状态管理与生产级容错设计。

schemas.headline: WebGPU 浏览器端深度学习：从 WebNN 到实时推理
schemas.description: 探索 WebGPU 在浏览器端运行深度学习模型的可能性，从 API 设计到 Shader 优化，实现浏览器内的实时推理引擎。

schemas.headline: 如何客观看待现今女权主义
schemas.description: 从理性与共情出发，探讨当代女权主义的多面性、常见误解与性别平等的真正含义。

schemas.headline: 图像处理流水线设计：从像素到决策的全链路优化
schemas.description: 设计一套高性能图像处理流水线，覆盖预处理、增强、推理、后处理全链路，实现工业级视觉检测系统的端到端优化。

schemas.headline: 「内卷」与「躺平」：一代人的焦虑与突围
schemas.description: 当内卷成为常态，躺平成为反抗，当代年轻人是否还有第三条路？

schemas.headline: SAM2 工业质检实战：交互式分割在缺陷检测中的应用
schemas.description: 将 SAM2 引入工业质检场景，实现交互式缺陷分割与标注，结合 YOLO 检测器构建半自动标注流水线。
